picks.blurb: When a prominent figure collapses at a high-society gala in the haunted town of Wraith's Hollow, all eyes turn to Dr. Mara Ellis, therapist, outsider, and the last person seen with the victim. Enter Jake Mercer, a former undercover operative hiding behind an alias and a troubled past. He knows a cover-up when he sees one, and he knows Mara is being framed. But Wraith's Hollow doesn't give up its secrets easily. As Jake and Mara dig into the town's murky underbelly, they uncover a chilling conspiracy rooted in decades of lies, betrayal, and buried trauma. Every clue pulls them deeper into a labyrinth of corrupted power, ghost stories that aren't just legend, and a killer who knows exactly what they're doing. Because in Wraith's Hollow, the past doesn't stay buried. And someone is willing to kill to keep the truth hidden.

intro: This page pairs a solo psychological thriller feature for San Angelo readers with a short story you can read free right here, plus HUNTED, the Ryan Kane Series Prequel, free on BookFunnel. Neither Stump Lewis's novel nor the Ryan Kane Series is set in San Angelo or Texas. They are gathered on one page so readers looking for dark, tense fiction can check the premise, read a complete short story in about 4 minutes, and decide where to start. The featured book is Stump Lewis's Hollow Trust, a Jake Mercer and Mara Ellis psychological thriller set in Wraith's Hollow. A prominent figure collapses at a high-society gala, suspicion lands on therapist Dr. Mara Ellis, and former undercover operative Jake Mercer steps in because he recognizes a cover-up when he sees one. It is a paid BookFunnel edition, linked once below. After the feature sits Streetlight Math, a complete short story set late at night in a strip-mall parking lot where Ryan Kane counts the streetlights to stay grounded when a dark sedan pulls in. Streetlight Math was written for that series, and it is not a chapter cut from a novel. Under the story, you will find HUNTED free on BookFunnel, FRACTURED GROUND on Kindle, and the Digital Ascent ARC on BookSprout.
